texts: good. the query binds "the Council" as an ordinary council (capitalized, but the sentence never states a proper name) as the party doing the meeting and leaves the time of the meeting open, with no tense invented for the present habitual. One thing to know: this asks for the meeting's time slot (which day, which hour), not its rate — a fact recorded only as a frequency like "every two weeks" would not come back, so ask "How often does the Council meet?" when the rate is what you want.
